name: ibrahim-elkhansa
description: Claude Code skills and mods by Ibrahim El Khansa. They include a market study, a lead finder, code explained as n8n style workflows, a picker page for open choices, a game clip trimmer, a toolbar above the prompt and a usage watcher.

plugins.name: study-competition
plugins.description: Studies the market around a business idea, with competitors, prices, their ads and bad reviews, the gaps nobody fills, selling points and video hooks, and where the idea already works abroad.

plugins.name: find-leads
plugins.description: Finds leads for a business idea, checks each one, and drafts one tailored first message per lead. It never sends anything.

plugins.name: explain-n8n
plugins.description: Explains a piece of code as an interactive n8n style workflow page, with steps, branches, loops, real code lines and example runs.

plugins.name: open-choices
plugins.description: Turns a wide open choice into a browsable page of many options on shelves, with Want and Maybe marks that Claude reads back afterwards.

plugins.name: trim-clip
plugins.description: Keeps the last 30 seconds (or any length) of a game clip or recording as a compressed 1080p MP4, without touching the original.

plugins.name: legal-review
plugins.description: Reviews how legally safe a project is: privacy law, the current terms of every outside service it uses, open-source and asset licences, consumer and content rules, and AI rules, for the countries it is aimed at. Not legal advice.

plugins.name: toolbar
plugins.description: A mod that adds a band above the prompt with the chat's pixel character and its helper agents, a files changed summary, and the context window as a stacked bar.

plugins.name: usage-watch
plugins.description: A mod that answers /usage-now and /cost-now in chat, and has Claude mention it when the five hour window passes 80% or the context passes 70% and 85%.
